title: Rotated sorted array: find the sorted half, then decide

steps.caption: A sorted array rotated at some point. Search 6. Key fact: around any mid, at least one half is sorted normally.
The RIGHT half 3..12 is sorted. Is 6 inside it? Yes: go right.
a[lo] ≤ a[mid], so the LEFT half 6..9 is sorted. Is 6 inside it? Yes: go left.
